name: io.github.ipvolt/account
title: ipvolt account
description: Mobile proxies at ipvolt: prices and stock, buy with x402 (USDC), rent and rotate with an API key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. What is on sale, its prices and buying a proxy with an x402 payment (buy_proxy) need no credential. For the account tools, set this to the word Bearer, a space and an ipvolt API key from your dashboard. Renting and extending spend the prepaid balance after a confirmation step; a read-only key cannot spend.
